seoDescription: Browse Fayette County Public Schools calendars for Lexington, Kentucky, with reviewed student dates, conditional weather make-up days, official PDFs and ICS downloads.
districtFact: FCPS publishes month-by-month student calendars that distinguish scheduled no-class days from dates the superintendent may activate for weather make-up. The district also publishes program-specific calendars, and William Wells Brown Elementary follows a slightly different Promise Academy schedule.
calendarNotes: Use the annual Students & Families calendar for districtwide dates, but check the assigned school or program before making plans. The Fayette County Preschool Program has its own calendar, and William Wells Brown Elementary follows a slightly different Promise Academy schedule. Weather make-up dates remain conditional until FCPS makes an official announcement. MySchoolDates ICS files are one-time imports and do not update automatically.
